title: Consegna: quota teatro, uscite with sign, Altobelli check
subtitle: GASS 2.28.0 — mockup design/mockups/consegna-teatro-foglio.html
context:
Three changes decided with the mockup `design/mockups/consegna-teatro-foglio.html` (2026-10-07):

1. **Cassa** — the Conto produttore field must say to enter the *importo effettivo* of the Altobelli Google Sheet; rounding of the Altobelli payment goes into the uscite di cassa, which must accept a **sign** (esce / entra), set by tapping a badge or typing +/−. Mockup option **C1**.
2. **Quota teatro** — the separate box (open, type, "Registra quota") is replaced by layout **A1**: in the same card a *Fresco* block and a *Teatro* block, each with its own versato, one Salva, and a summary of where the money goes physically (cassa vs bussolotto).
3. **Altobelli check** — compare the day's tab of the sheet "Selvaggio Altobelli 26" (shared with anyone with the link) with the conti in GASS: sum of the **effettivi** row by row (the sheet's `=SUM` sometimes misses rows: 29/9 showed 319,20 instead of 357,20), handle effettivi not filled in. **Admin only, desktop only, experimental, separate tab.**

This supersedes the earlier answers given before the mockup (Teatro section open to everyone, only a link in the consegna, payments kept when a consegna is deleted): page 2 asks again where they still apply. App strings stay Italian; this plan is in English because fluidplan supports en/fr only. Every UI change ships on mobile **and** desktop (project rule), except the Altobelli check (desktop by request).

glossary.definition: Column C of each tab of the Altobelli sheet: the real amount each person owes after weighing. Column B (importo approssimativo) is the estimate made at order time.
The separate box holding the quote teatro (cassa teatro), never mixed with the consegna cassa.
Cash taken out of the consegna cassa by hand, table `uscite_cassa` (importo, motivo). Today importo must be > 0.
Numeric id of one tab inside a Google Sheet; `export?format=csv&gid=<gid>` downloads exactly that tab.
What a person still owes in quota teatro across all semesters (`statoTeatro` in server/services/teatro.js).

pages.title: Conto produttore and uscite with a sign
pages.intro: Decide how the sign of an uscita is stored, typed and shown.

decisions.title: How the sign is stored
decisions.why: It sets the meaning of every stored row and of the cassa formula `lasciato = trovato + incassato − pagato − Σ uscite`. Getting it backwards would silently flip the 29/9 uscita of 90 € and every lasciato recomputed after it.
decisions.proposal: Keep the column as is: **importo > 0 = esce** (as today, the 29/9 row of 90 stays valid), **importo < 0 = entra** (e.g. Altobelli paid 357 instead of 357,20 → −0,20). The formula does not change: Σ uscite simply becomes smaller when there is an entrata. 0 is still refused.

options.label: Positive = esce, negative = entra
cons: The stored sign is the opposite of the effect on the cassa (a reader of the DB must know it)

options.label: Store the effect on the cassa (− = esce)
options.detail: Migration negates existing rows; formula becomes `+ Σ movimenti di cassa`.
pros: The stored sign reads like the cassa
cons: Every reader (report, storico, mobile recompute) changes

tasks.title: Accept negative uscite in validation
tasks.do: In `validateConsegnaPayload` (`server/services/validation.js`, the `body.uscite` loop) accept any finite non-zero importo instead of > 0; keep the motivo required. Error text stays 'Indica l'importo di ogni uscita di cassa'.
acceptance: `{importo: -0.2, motivo: 'arrotondamento'}` passes
`{importo: 0, motivo: 'x'}` is refused
`{importo: -0.2, motivo: ''}` is refused

tasks.title: Cover a negative uscita in the consegna API
tasks.do: Integration test: POST /api/consegna with uscite `[{90,'teatro'},{0.8,'arrotondamento Altobelli'},{-0.2,'arrotondamento'}]`; GET returns them in order and the stored lasciato equals trovato + incassato − pagato − 90,60.
acceptance: lasciato_in_cassa is computed with Σ uscite = 90,60

decisions.title: How the sign is entered
decisions.why: You asked to be able both to tap the badge and to type the sign. If the two disagree the turnista cannot tell what will be saved.
decisions.proposal: Each uscita row starts with a **badge button** `esce` / `entra` (tap = toggle). Typing a leading **−** or **+** in the importo sets the badge (**− = esce, + = entra**, i.e. the effect on the cassa, as in the cassa line "− Uscite") and the sign is removed from the field, which always shows the amount without sign. A new row starts on `esce`. The badge is the single source of truth: `readUscite` sends `importo` positive for esce, negative for entra.
decisions.learn_more: Why − means esce: the cassa line reads Trovato + Incassato − Pagato − Uscite, so a minus is money leaving the box. The opposite reading ("− = less paid to Altobelli") was considered and rejected because it depends on the motivo. `normalizeInputField` already rewrites the field on input; the sign handling hooks into the same `oninput`.

options.label: Badge + typed sign, − = esce
pros: The field never shows a sign, so no ambiguity after typing
cons: Typed − meaning esce must be learned (the tip says it)

options.label: Badge + typed sign, − = entra
pros: Matches the stored value of option C1-recommended
cons: Opposite of the cassa line, easy to get wrong at the consegna

tasks.title: Add the esce/entra badge to uscita rows
tasks.do: In `usciteRowHtml` (`public/js/shared/consegna-common.js`) prepend `<button type="button" class="uscita-segno" data-segno="out|in">esce|entra</button>`; click toggles and calls `onNoteGiornataChange()`. On importo input, a leading `-`/`−`/`+` sets `data-segno` and is stripped before `normalizeInputField`. `readUscite` returns `importo` = amount × (in ? −1 : 1). `fillGiornata` renders stored negatives as `entra` with the absolute value. Styles `.uscita-segno` (debito/verde tints as in the mockup) in `public/style.css`; grid of `.uscita` gets the extra column on mobile and desktop.
acceptance: Typing '-0,80' shows badge esce and field '0,80'
Typing '+0,20' shows badge entra
Tapping the badge flips it and marks the giornata as changed
A stored −0,20 reloads as entra 0,20
Works at 390 px and on desktop

decisions.title: How signed uscite are shown
decisions.why: Storico, the cassa line and the Telegram report already describe uscite; an entrata shown without a sign would read as money out.
decisions.proposal: Descriptions list motivi with the amount; an entrata gets a typographic **+** ("teatro 90, arrotondamento Altobelli 0,80, arrotondamento +0,20"); a single uscita keeps showing only its motivo. The total shown is the net Σ (90,60); if the net is negative the label reads "Entrate di cassa" with the absolute value. Same rule in `descrizioneUscite` (client) and `descrizione` (report.js).

tasks.do: Update `descrizioneUscite` and `updateUsciteView` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js` and `descrizione` in `server/services/report.js` (keep them identical, as the existing comment requires).
acceptance: Report text for uscite 90 / 0,80 / −0,20 reads 'Uscite di cassa: 90,60 € (teatro 90, arrotondamento Altobelli 0,80, arrotondamento +0,20)'

decisions.title: Wording of Conto produttore and of the uscite help
decisions.why: The point of change 1 and 2 is that turnisti read it at the consegna; hidden text in a tip alone is not enough for the conto.

Esce = tolti (es. hai pagato Altobelli 358 invece di 357,20: 0,80), entra = rimessi (hai pagato 357: 0,20). Tocca esce/entra o scrivi − / + davanti all'importo. Per toglierne una svuota la riga."*

decisions.title: Layout A1 in the card

decisions.proposal: The card gets two blocks: **Fresco** (Conto produttore, Importo versato, computed credit/debt lines — unchanged logic) and **Quota teatro** (rows "lug–dic 2026, da pagare 15 €", field *Versato per il teatro*, result "pagata" / "restano X" / "anticipo X"). At the bottom a summary *"Ha dato 46 €: 31 in cassa fresco, 15 nel bussolotto teatro"*. One **Salva** saves both. The old `openTeatro` / `registraTeatro` box and the "Quota teatro non registrata" warning go away. Same on mobile (full-screen card) and desktop (form card).

tasks.title: Render the Teatro block and the money summary in the card
tasks.do: In `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js` replace `teatroButtonHtml` / `openTeatro` / `renderTeatro` / `registraTeatro` with `teatroBlockHtml(id)` rendered by `renderParticipant` (rows from `GET /api/teatro/utente/:id`, FIFO preview with the existing `teatroAllocate`) and `riepilogoSoldi(id)` updated on every input of versato fresco / versato teatro. Remove the unsaved-quota confirm in `saveParticipant`. Keep the `data-tip="teatro_versato"` on the new label. decisions.title: How the teatro amount is saved
decisions.why: Fresco and teatro are saved by one button: if they go through two requests, a network error halfway leaves a movimento without its quota (or the reverse) with nothing telling the turnista.
decisions.proposal: Each participant in `POST /api/consegna` gets an optional `teatroVersato`. The server writes it in the **same transaction** as the movimento: it **replaces** that person's teatro payment in this consegna (delete + insert, so reopening and re-saving a movimento never doubles it; 0 removes it). Validation: ≥ 0, cents. `POST /api/teatro/pagamenti` stays for admin use only.

options.label: Same request, replace per person+consegna
pros: Editing a saved movimento edits its quota too

options.label: Two requests from the client, add-only
cons: Re-saving a movimento adds the quota again

tasks.title: Save teatroVersato inside POST /api/consegna
tasks.do: In `server/routes/consegna.js` (POST `/`, inside `db.transaction`) for each participant with `teatroVersato != null`: `DELETE FROM teatro_pagamenti WHERE consegna_id = ? AND user_id = ?` then, if > 0, `registraPagamento(db, {userId, importo, data: consegna.data, consegnaId})` from `server/services/teatro.js` (call `ensureSemestre` first). Log `teatro_pagamento` with `logActivity` only when the amount changed. Validate in `server/services/validation.js` (number ≥ 0). Restrict `POST /api/teatro/pagamenti` in `server/routes/teatro.js` to `requireAdmin` (keep its open-consegna rule).
acceptance: Saving a movimento with teatroVersato 15 creates one payment dated the consegna
Saving it again with 15 leaves one payment, with 0 leaves none
A validation error rolls back both movimento and payment
Non-admin POST /api/teatro/pagamenti → 403

tasks.title: Send teatroVersato from the card
tasks.do: Add `teatroVersato` to `readMovimentoForm(id)` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js` (from the Teatro block field; omitted when the block is not rendered). After save, refresh `participants[].teatro_residuo` and the day's list (`addTeatroToList` becomes a reload of `m.teatro`). `populateExistingMovimento` fills the field with `m.teatro`.

decisions.title: Is the quota still tied to the consegna?
decisions.why: Before the mockup you answered "pagamenti restano" and "solo un link". With A1 the quota is paid inside the movimento again, so that answer may no longer hold; picking wrong either deletes real teatro payments with a consegna or leaves orphan quotas in the day's list.
decisions.proposal: Keep it **tied, as today**: payment dated the consegna, shown in the day's list ("quota teatro 15"), in "Quote teatro di questa consegna" and in the Telegram report; deleting a consegna (admin) deletes its quotas, with the existing warning and `teatro_modifica` log.

pros: Nothing changes in list, report, storico
Deleting a wrong consegna removes everything it recorded

options.label: Tied for display, kept on consegna delete
pros: A deleted consegna never loses money already in the bussolotto
cons: Orphan payments pointing to a deleted consegna_id
Re-entering the consegna would double them

pages.title: Altobelli check (experimental, admin, desktop)
pages.intro: Decide where the check lives, how GASS reads the sheet and how sheet names map to people.

decisions.title: Where the check lives
decisions.why: Experimental means it must be easy to ignore or remove without touching the consegna page everyone uses.
decisions.proposal: A separate desktop page **/altobelli**, nav item *"Altobelli (prova)"* shown only to admins (like Attività). A date selector, default the consegna opened by the apertura rule (`GET /api/consegna/apertura`), any past date allowed. Shows the table of the mockup (nome nel foglio, persona, effettivo foglio, conto in app, esito) with "mostra solo le differenze", and the KPIs Σ effettivi riga per riga, totale scritto nel foglio, Σ conti in app, pagato ad Altobelli.

options.label: Separate page /altobelli
pros: Removable by deleting files + one nav item
cons: Admin must open another tab during the check

options.label: Admin-only section in consegna-desktop
cons: Experimental code inside the main page

tasks.title: Create the /altobelli desktop page
tasks.do: Create `public/altobelli-desktop.html` and `public/js/altobelli-desktop.js` (script order of CLAUDE.md, date field via `initDateField`), route `/altobelli` in `server/routes/pages.js` (desktop; mobile redirects to /consegna), nav `<li id="nav-altobelli" class="initially-hidden">` in every desktop page toggled with `#nav-logs` in `public/js/shared/auth.js`. Table shows the 6 row states of the mockup

decisions.title: How GASS reads the sheet
decisions.why: Tested 2026-10-07: the easy endpoint (`gviz/tq?sheet=<name>`) returns **another tab silently** when the name does not match — the check would compare the wrong consegna and look fine. The method must fail loudly.
decisions.proposal: No credentials, no new dependency: fetch `…/htmlview` to get tab name → gid (regex on `name: "6 ottobre" … gid=758064518`), then `…/export?format=csv&gid=<gid>` (exact tab, rows in place). Parse: find the row whose column C is `effettivi`; data rows below until the first row with empty column A; amounts like `€ 37,61` / `23` parsed Italian. Empty C = *effettivo non segnato* (B kept as reference only). Σ effettivi computed row by row; the total row (A empty, C numeric) shown as "totale scritto nel foglio" — CSV gives its displayed value (`319,5`, 1 decimal), so compare with 0,05 tolerance. Any fetch/parse failure → clear error on the page, no partial table. Read on page load and on "aggiorna", never cached in DB.
decisions.learn_more: Rejected: xlsx export (`export?format=xlsx`, 1 MB) would give formulas (the `=SUM(C9:C20)` range) but needs a parser dependency in the image. The htmlview page is undocumented HTML: if Google changes it the regex breaks — the error is then explicit, and the fallback is a manual gid field on the page.

options.label: xlsx export + SheetJS
pros: Formulas visible (can show the wrong SUM range)

decisions.title: Mapping sheet names to people
decisions.why: Sheet names are free text ("Paoletta m", "frankkie", "S&P" for a household): without a stored mapping every check would ask again.
decisions.proposal: New table `altobelli_nomi (nome TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)`; `nome` stored lower-case trimmed. Unknown names show a select "a chi corrisponde?" on the page; saving it maps for all future tabs. First guess (not saved until confirmed): case-insensitive match on display_name or its first word.

tasks.title: Create the altobelli_nomi table
tasks.do: Add `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS altobelli_nomi (…)` in `server/config/database.js` next to `settings`. `deleteUser` in `server/services/users.js` is unaffected (CASCADE).
acceptance: Fresh and existing DBs get the table at startup

decisions.title: Sheet link setting
decisions.why: Leonardo opens a new sheet each year ("25 26", then "26"); a hardcoded id would break silently at the switch.
decisions.proposal: `settings` key `altobelli_foglio` (full URL), editable by admins in a field at the top of /altobelli; initial value the current sheet "Selvaggio Altobelli 26".

tasks.title: Store the sheet URL in settings

acceptance: An URL without a spreadsheet id is refused (400)

decisions.title: Finding the tab of a consegna
decisions.why: Tab names vary: "6 ottobre", "Mercoledì 8 aprile", "30  giugno" (two spaces), and a second order "23a  giugno" in the same week.
decisions.proposal: Normalise (lower-case, collapse spaces) and match tabs containing `<day> <month name>` or `<day>a <month name>`. One match → used; several → a selector on the page; none → "nessuna scheda per il 6 ottobre nel foglio".

tasks.title: Match tabs by date with a selector for duplicates
tasks.do: Implement `findTab(tabs, date)` in `server/services/altobelli.js` returning all candidates; the page shows a select when > 1 and passes `gid` back to the API.
acceptance: '2026-06-23' returns both '23 giugno' and '23a  giugno'
'2026-04-08' matches 'Mercoledì 8 aprile'
